english: Commander! Don't you look rested. I see the lack of Elder Dragon threats is treating you well.

Commander. Do we still call you "Commander"? Oh, never mind that. Hellie. Priory archivist.
Commander. Heard you're headed back into the pass. I'll be right there—
Commander. You here to help us liberate this little weapons stash from its unworthy owners?
Commander. Your help in this operation won't go unnoticed. It's a boon to the novice agents to see the inner circle getting their hands dirty in the field.
